record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo (Clobbopus 1 star, Grapploct 2 stars, passive NONE) declare OCTOLOCK in this production reference. Shared strategy.
record.summary: Single-target SPECIAL damage (30 raw at 1 star, 60 at 2 stars), then the same duration is requested for two statuses on the target: LOCKED and armor reduction (halves the target's def and speDef while active). Order: damage, then LOCKED, then armor reduction. Both durations are 3000 ms for 1 and 2 stars (6000 at 3 stars, 10000 for 4 or more; not reachable by the two listed units). Because the damage is dealt first, the halving from this cast does not affect this cast's damage, only an armor reduction already active on the target does. LOCKED and armor reduction are independent: a refused LOCKED (already locked, skydiving, runeProtect, IMMUNITY_LOCKED, or CC cooldown) does not stop the armor reduction, and runeProtect blocks both.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); a cast crit multiplies by critPower reduced by the target's critReductionFactor (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: requested amount = raw x AP x crit factor; applied: handleDamage divides by (1 + 0.05 x speDef) with speDef halved (Math.round) if the target already had armor reduction before this cast, ceil, minimum 1, shield first; takenDamage is not used by this ability. Blocked (0) by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (magicBounce may reflect SPECIAL damage unless the caster holds Protective Pads) and for a dead or resurrecting target. Statuses below are still requested after a blocked hit.

statusEffects.applicationOrder: after the damage, before armor reduction
statusEffects.guards: refused when the target is already locked (no stacking), skydiving, has runeProtect, has the IMMUNITY_LOCKED effect, or has ccCooldown > 0; an enraged target gets half the duration; then applyStatusDurationReductions (SWIFT_SWIM x0.7, HYDRATION x0.5, WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER x0.3, Odd Keystone -10% per stone); the cooldown is set to the rounded result
statusEffects.combatEffect: target range forced to 1 (a retarget is forced if it was not 1); a locked unit cannot move (canMove) and cannot be moved by effects (canBeMoved); cannot dodge a basic attack (dodge roll skipped in handleAttack); the dark-type jump in MovingState is disabled. When LOCKED ends the range is restored and a CC cooldown begins during which LOCKED is refused. Whether the target can still attack or cast while locked: canAttack and canCast do not test locked.

statusEffects.guards: not applied with runeProtect; the duration passes through applyStatusDurationReductions; a new value replaces the remaining time only if longer
statusEffects.combatEffect: while active, PokemonState.handleDamage uses round(def / 2) and round(speDef / 2) when computing damage taken by the target (also seen in the Power Lens retaliation computation); it does not change the stored stat values.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the caster's stars; the 3 and 4 star values (90 / 180 damage, 6000 / 10000 ms) are not reachable by the two listed units. maxPP 65 and range 1 for both.

record.positionalConditions: None read beyond needing a target (range 1 for both units).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. A second cast during LOCKED does not re-lock (no stacking) but still applies damage and can lengthen armor reduction; after LOCKED ends the CC cooldown refuses a new lock for its duration.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 30 / 60, duration 3000 ms for both statuses (1 and 2 stars). Damage dealt = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then speDef division (ceil, at least 1). Durations are requested values: enraged halves LOCKED only; applyStatusDurationReductions then shortens both; the lock may be refused entirely.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Shield, Cover Band, Fossil and resurrection branches of handleDamage were not traced here (takenDamage is unused by OCTOLOCK); consulted core-mechanics.md section A and the speDef step only
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence): only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read
The value of CC_COOLDOWN and whether other systems read status.locked were not exhaustively searched (app/core and app/models were grepped; other directories were not)
unresolved: How a locked unit's basic attacks or casts behave beyond canMove / canBeMoved / dodge / dark jump was not traced further
Whether passives or items change LOCKED or armorReduction beyond those listed (a passive resets lockedCooldown at app/core/effects/passives.ts:1682, not read in detail)
No other unit sharing the identifier exists in the queue; units not listed are not covered
Mechanical checks only; no probe was run and no fight observed
